current_writer_scope: Retained native source/account replay and all-cell scalar covariance verification; no fresh physical transport or native R execution
limits: All results are conditional two-token composition, not full vegetation or authenticated historical source reconstruction
Each radius association and named chronology remains its own declared scenario; alternate chronologies and repeated unit datasets are never simultaneous sites
Independent conditional multinomial counts and diagonal cross-taxon public PPE covariance are assumptions
Shared PPE creates possible cross-result dependence; exported2x2covariance is within each result only
Bog receiver-law applicability is not admitted by these lake scenarios
Published generic Pinus cannot silently authenticate Pinus sylvestris, and new physical tuples need independent integration qualification
Current public analytical-use component has captured source policy support; new publication citations, historical workbook/private rights and ecological PPE transfer remain separate
No independent vegetation accuracy, unfamiliar-reader validation, untouched confirmation or release closure
Distinct native unit IDs establish deduplication, not empirical statistical independence
Within-result covariance only; shared PPE implies possible cross-result dependence, no joint time-series covariance exported
No historical1128source replay, total vegetation, independent vegetation accuracy, untouched confirmation, qualified external review, reader/application exercise or release completion

native_producer_authority.scope: Actual immutable native result custody; maintained publisher replays accounts and scalar covariance, not physical fits, integrations or raw-source acquisition

scientific_assumptions.PPE_dependence: Shared two-entry PPE vector across sites; diagonal public SD² across taxa. No independent per-site PPE draw approximation.
scientific_assumptions.age_support: Use only the exact named native calibrated chronology point ages; BP datum AD1950 per official Neotoma manual7.5. Publication year and collection year never reset zeroBP. Source raw negative ages retained as outside these nonnegative windows, not invalid BP dates. No chronology posterior or zero-width certainty inferred from missing bounds.
scientific_assumptions.consumer: Source-supported two-literal-taxon physical composition and shared-PPE multisite covariance on separately named native calBP chronology profiles
scientific_assumptions.count_weighting: Maintained fixed-site method sums count/(site-specific deposition*shared PPE); counts determine weights, not basin area or regional land area.
scientific_assumptions.cross_result_covariance_scope: Shared PPE induces possible cross-window/grid dependence; exported covariance is within result only, no joint covariance or posterior.
scientific_assumptions.distinct_unit_scope: Native unit IDs establish identity deduplication; independent conditional multinomial counts is an explicit assumption, not empirical site independence.
scientific_assumptions.geographic_grid_association: Original workbook grid ID association is a declared grouping assumption, not authenticated historical dataset selection or independent regional coverage.
scientific_assumptions.geometry: Metadata radius interpreted as a static circular uniformly weighted receiving disk; land annulus begins at disk edge and ends at100km. No claim of time-varying historical basin or measured physical kernel. TIB altitude inconsistency161m versus568m and398m coordinate separation retained; no authenticated historical match.

literal_panels.published_comparator_taxon_scope: Exact published Betula/Poaceae or Betula/Ulmus column names can be separately projected
Exact published Betula/Poaceae or Betula/Ulmus column names can be separately projected
Published Pinus column is generic; species-token mapping is not admitted by literal source-label equality

scientific_assumptions.parameter_covariance_scope: Public per-taxon SDs are used with diagonal cross-taxon PPE covariance as explicit zero-covariance assumption; no ecological transfer verification.
scientific_assumptions.pooling_chronology_policy: Supported native default chronology if available; otherwise smallest supported named calibrated chronology ID, declared comparison scenario only. Alternate chronology scenarios never simultaneous sites.
scientific_assumptions.pooling_window_policy: Enumerate all25 declared windows for each fixed grid membership; classify complete/partial/allmembersabsent. Only complete observed membership gives numerical result, never impute missing sample or unit.

scientific_assumptions.rights_scope: Current captured Neotoma/EPD public policy supports public analytical-use component with native DOI/PI/database attribution. Historical workbook/private author rights remain separate; primary citations are complete only for16 original19 used datasets, so new dataset publishing needs exact citation follow-through.
scientific_assumptions.source_source_presence: Two literal unique native taxon datum observations per source sample and positive selected-panel mass; missing/duplicate/allzero panel samples remain exclusions.
scientific_assumptions.taxon_support: Two exact unique literal source datum labels per sample; public parameter rows are computational transfer tokens, no ecological equivalence admitted
scientific_assumptions.transport_units: Radii/distances metres, fall/wind m/s. Source GPM diffusion_coefficient0.12 is empirical metre-based transport coefficient, not SI diffusivity m²/s; exponent is turbulence_parameter/2=0.125. Radius0.5×/2× means area0.25×/4× under A=πr², not half/double area.
scientific_assumptions.uncertainty: Maintained fixed-site delta covariance: independent fixed-total multinomial counts per single pooled core-window; diagonal covariance of public PPE SD squared, shared across window taxa with all off-diagonal entries assumed0. Chronology, radius, wind, site selection and physical response held fixed for conditional SE; separate declared geometry/wind sensitivity profiles are not probability intervals.
scientific_assumptions.uncertainty_held_fixed: Native named chronology point ages, fixed membership, source selection, static basin geometry and physical transport within each finite scenario; no calibrated age posterior or geographic bootstrap.
